_options.modality: image | sketch | text  (text only works with siglip)
_options.comparison_view: panorama (all 4 headings, matched one enlarged) | single (just the matched image)
_options.n_places: how many of the 20 test places each participant rates (least-used places are handed out first)
_options.n_repeats: consistency check: comparisons per place shown a second time (0 = off)
_options.practice: true = start with a practice block of 4 comparisons (place p00)
_options.completion_url: Prolific's completion link (participants are sent there at the end)
_options.completion_code: Prolific's completion code (shown on the thank-you page)
